key.name: api-base-url
key.description: OpenAI-compatible endpoint, usually ending in /v1. The default is Penguin’s free tier.

key.name: api-key
key.description: On the free tier Penguin makes its own key the first time it asks something.

key.name: model
key.description: Must accept image input for screen questions.

key.name: allow-insecure-tls
key.summary: Accept TLS certificates that don’t validate
key.description: Needed behind an intercepting proxy (e.g. Burp) or a captive/campus network. Turns off protection against a real man-in-the-middle, so leave off unless you need it.

key.name: custom-instructions
key.summary: Extra instructions appended to the system prompt

key.name: translate-language
key.summary: Language that English text is translated into
key.description: Text in any other language is translated into English.

key.name: show-indicator
key.summary: Show the Penguin icon in the top bar

key.name: ask-selection
key.summary: Ask about the selection or clipboard
